article.headline: Anton Strelnikov scores 16, Dartmouth defeats Elms College 107-43
article.description: — Anton Strelnikov's 16 points helped Dartmouth defeat Elms College 107-43 on Thursday.
article.linkText: Anton Strelnikov scores 16, Dartmouth defeats Elms College 107-43
article.story: HANOVER, N.H. -- — Anton Strelnikov's 16 points helped Dartmouth defeat Elms College 107-43 on Thursday. Strelnikov added six rebounds for the Big Green (6-7). Niko Abusara scored 13 points while going 6 of 10 from the field and added five rebounds. Brandon Mitchell-Day finished 5 of 8 from the field to finish with 12 points. Arik Dagan led the way for the Blazers with eight points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
